featured_reviews.name: Gagandeep Mehra
featured_reviews.review_text:
This is related to my order number 25171.

The after-sales service has been extremely disappointing and unprofessional.

I had clearly communicated my intent to place a bulk order for 80 players. However, despite this, your team refused to provide even a basic sample. As a result, I was compelled to place an order through your portal at my own cost, purely to evaluate the product before confirming a bulk purchase.

Upon delivery, I observed clear discrepancies between what was advertised on your portal and what was actually delivered:
•	The design and color displayed on the portal show a light shade, whereas the product delivered is in a noticeably darker shade.
•	The collar color, as shown on the portal, matches the jersey color; however, the delivered product has a black collar, which is a clear deviation.

While the fabric quality and printing are satisfactory, the delivered product does not match the specifications and representation on your platform, which amounts to misrepresentation.

Instead of acknowledging and rectifying the issue, your team has offered a conditional resolution—providing one free jersey only if a bulk order is placed. This is unacceptable. It effectively shifts the burden of your error onto the customer and compels us to proceed with a larger order despite a negative experience.

I have already incurred a loss of ₹499 due to this mismatch, which is entirely due to your failure to deliver as advertised. As a customer, I should not be expected to bear this loss.

This conduct reflects poor customer service and raises concerns about your commitment to transparency and accountability.

I request the following actions on priority:
•	A full refund/replacement for the incorrect product delivered
•	A clear explanation for the mismatch between the portal display and actual product
•	Assurance that such discrepancies will not occur in future bulk orders

Please treat this as a formal complaint. If not resolved promptly, I will be compelled to escalate this matter through appropriate consumer grievance channels.

Appreciate your response at the earliest.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
THIS SEEMS VERY INTENTIONAL, WE SENT NEW JERSEY AND YOU AGREED THAT YOU LIKED THE PREVIOUS ONE (FOR WHICH YOU WROTE SUCH LONG NEGATIVE REVIEW)
We delivered new jersey worth 499 without any extra charges, completely free, and you suddenly like the fabric of previous one.

(off topic - but our team checked your other reviews also with other business and found that you usually write negative on internet)

We are genuinely sorry that your experience did not meet expectations. However, we would like to clarify the situation for transparency.

During your order, there was an error from our side regarding the collar color, and we accepted responsibility for it. To resolve the issue, we provided you with a completely new jersey free of cost (worth ₹499) with the corrected blue collar, without any additional charges.

We also tried our best to support you and maintain goodwill, especially since you had mentioned plans for a future team order. Even after the replacement was delivered successfully, we remained available to assist and politely requested an update to the review if the issue had been resolved.

We never intended to inconvenience or mislead you at any point.

At Dika Sports, customer satisfaction is very important to us, and we always try our best to resolve genuine issues fairly and professionally. We respect all feedback, but we also believe it is important to present the complete picture for future customers.
